pages.text: Mighty items, for the dark mage who climbs the peak.
Berserk Essence: feed it to one of your Mutant Zombie servants or a Sediment Lord for two minutes of frenzy; feeding it again only refreshes the timer.
Concentrated Bone Chunk: right-click a Mutant Skeleton servant with it to strengthen it, up to five times; also a crafting material.
Shining Wither Skull: a wither skull you can place for show, the row of skulls atop a wither's summoning structure, and a crafting material besides.
Prison Steel Block: faintly glowing steel and the heart of a Prison Golem's mold; right-click a Prison Golem with it to restore 100 health.

Mobile Prison: unfolds into a 3x3x3 cage (door facing north) when placed. Record it by right-clicking any cell with Goety's Waystone, then right-click your Prison Golem to bind the cage to it - captives are sent into its cell first.
Haunted Soul Sand: sinks your feet the way soul sand does; it is the block the skulls of a wither's summoning structure are laid on.
Vitality Carved Pumpkin: the pumpkin that caps a golem's summoning structure - a plain vanilla pumpkin will not do.
Vitality Pumpkin Lantern: caps a summoning structure just the same, with 15 levels of light of its own.
